items.change: Father William marked the witch's home and the Barrow Mound on the party's map, and the party planned to check a marked location on the way to the Barrow.
items.impact_basis: Beat_46 adds new locations to the map and beat_69 makes a marked site part of the route, but the treasure itself stays unfound.
items.lasting_basis: The marked sites from beat_46 and the planned detour in beat_69 are likely to come up on the trip.

items.change: The party caught the Clurichen Naggeneen, who had been drinking the Golden Egg's ale, and handed him to Quinn, who hung him in a bag behind his bar.
items.impact_basis: Beats_31-34 answer who the Clurichen was and end with it captured, and it offered a pot of gold or a secret for its release.
items.lasting_basis: Naggeneen still hangs captive with his offer outstanding (beat_35), so he may well come up again.

items.change: George revealed the dragon's lair, its deadly poison and unpierceable scales, and that it will soon fly, while Father William said it can only be killed with Brandon's buried sword.
items.impact_basis: Beats_42 and 50-53 give the lair's location, the dragon's threats and the need for the sword, reshaping how the party will hunt it.
items.lasting_basis: The lair, the deadline before it flies and the doubtful bounty (beat_52) will shape later Sessions.

items.change: Nothing changed; shipments still had not arrived.
items.impact_basis: Beat_35 only restates that shipments haven't come in.
items.lasting_basis: The mystery continues but this Session added nothing to it.

items.change: The quarrel with Eric lapsed without a duel, though Sir Phidipaldi still disdains him.
items.impact_basis: Beat_52 shows only continued disdain, and no challenge was pursued.
items.lasting_basis: The thread is abandoned and nothing is owed.

items.change: Gill said he would lower the mule's price once his sons return.
items.impact_basis: Beat_3 is a small negotiation step with no deal made.
items.lasting_basis: The deal is deferred and may resume later.

items.change: Dunk scouted Warwick's magical mithril shirt and open bedroom window and told the party he has a plan to get it.
items.impact_basis: Beats_12 and 65 establish the magic armor, a way in and Dunk's intent to take it.
items.lasting_basis: Dunk's pending plan (beat_65) will likely play out next Session.

items.change: The ale thief was revealed as Naggeneen, not Bentley, and Quinn paid the party 33 gold each.
items.impact_basis: Beats_33-34 solve the mystery and close the job.
items.lasting_basis: The thread is resolved, and the payment is ordinary treasure.

items.change: Trout recruited Squints into his Halfling Corps for second pick of the first treasure, and Squints later got Brother Dirk as a follower.
items.impact_basis: Beat_38 adds a new companion on agreed terms, and beat_81 adds Dirk under him.
items.lasting_basis: The promised treasure share and the new companions will persist.

items.change: Dunk agreed to help the lovesick Ingrid drug Warwick with a sleeping potion, got faun wine from the fauns, and gave her a heavily diluted batch to brew it.
items.impact_basis: Beats_26-28, 59 and 70-71 form a concrete scheme that serves Dunk's armor heist.
items.lasting_basis: The potion and next meeting are pending (beat_71), and the diluted wine may backfire.

items.change: The party learned the dragon can only be slain with Brandon's sword, buried in a barrow three miles away, and set out to get it.
items.impact_basis: Beats_42, 53, 68 and 69 give the party a new main goal and route.
items.lasting_basis: The quest for the sword will drive the next Sessions.

items.change: Dr. Uriah promised Father William to do penance at the Barrow Mound and donate 10 gold for its upkeep.
items.impact_basis: Beat_46 creates a small obligation.
items.lasting_basis: The duty is due at the Barrow, where the party is heading.

items.change: The party rescued Brother Dirk from a giant's stewpot and outran the angry giant.
items.impact_basis: Beats_75-79 show a rescue that freed an NPC and created a foe.
items.lasting_basis: The awake, angry giant remains on the road to the Barrow.

items.change: The party learned which wares Ingrid sells.
items.impact_basis: Beat_21 is shop inventory.
items.lasting_basis: It may matter for later purchases.

items.change: Father William offered to heal Dr. Uriah if he is injured.
items.impact_basis: Beat_44 is a minor offer of aid.
items.lasting_basis: It might be used later.

items.change: Ingrid said fairies are emerging more often and that her forest friend Vivian sees them.
items.impact_basis: Beat_61 adds world context about rising fey activity and Vivian.
items.lasting_basis: Vivian and the fairies may come up later.

items.change: Dr. Uriah bought wolfsbane and mandrake root tea from Ingrid.
items.impact_basis: Beat_63 is a routine purchase.
items.lasting_basis: These are ordinary consumables.

items.change: Dunk drank with Farmer Gill and haggled over the mule.
items.impact_basis: Beats_1-3 are friendly drinking and a deferred deal.
items.lasting_basis: The mule deal is deferred.
items.encounter_basis: Colour and a haggle already covered by the mule thread.

items.change: Trout befriended Squints at the Clumsy Fox.
items.impact_basis: Beats_8-10 are a first meeting that leads to recruitment.
items.lasting_basis: Squints' later recruitment matters, but this meeting itself is a prelude.
items.encounter_basis: A first meeting whose result is told by the Halfling Corps thread.

items.change: Dunk scouted Warwick's shop and spotted Ingrid sneaking toward it.
items.impact_basis: Beat_12 shows the magic armor.
items.lasting_basis: It feeds the armor plan.
items.encounter_basis: Scouting already told by the mithril shirt thread.

items.change: Sir Phidipaldi set marbles in the Golden Egg's basement to trap the thief.
items.impact_basis: Beats_14-15 are setup only.
items.lasting_basis: This was transient setup.
items.encounter_basis: Setup for the capture, with no standalone value.

items.change: Uriah and Trout tracked the invisible Clurichen from the river.
items.impact_basis: Beat_19 is a pursuit leading to the capture.
items.lasting_basis: The tracking mattered only within the Session.
items.encounter_basis: A lead-in to the capture already told by the Clurichen thread.

items.change: Dunk learned Ingrid's secret love for Warwick and struck a sleeping-potion deal with her.
items.impact_basis: Beats_23 and 26-28 create the scheme.
items.lasting_basis: The deal continues.
items.encounter_basis: Its central agreement is the same event the Ingrid potion thread tells.

items.change: The party caught Naggeneen the ale thief and was paid by Quinn.
items.impact_basis: Beats_31-34 resolve the job.
items.lasting_basis: Naggeneen remains captive.
items.encounter_basis: A pivotal capture already told by the Clurichen and vanishing ale threads.

items.change: Squints joined Trout's Halfling Corps.
items.impact_basis: Beat_38 shows the recruitment.
items.lasting_basis: Squints persists as a companion.
items.encounter_basis: The recruitment is the same event the Halfling Corps thread tells.

items.change: Dr. Uriah endured Father William's suspicious inspection, learned of Brother Dirk and the sword, and agreed to do penance.
items.impact_basis: Beats_42 and 46 give key information and an obligation, amid hostile treatment (beats_41, 43).
items.lasting_basis: The priest's hostility and Uriah's penance persist.
items.encounter_basis: Father William's hostile, prejudiced reception of Uriah adds personal context beyond the sword facts and penance threads.

items.change: George told Sir Phidipaldi of the dragon's lair and deadly powers.
items.impact_basis: Beats_50-53 give major intelligence.
items.lasting_basis: It will shape the hunt.
items.encounter_basis: The visit to one-armed George is essentially the dragon intel the dragon thread tells.

items.change: Dunk outdrank the fauns and traded a rabbit's foot for a flask of their wine.
items.impact_basis: Beat_59 secures the potion ingredient.
items.lasting_basis: The wine feeds the potion plan.
items.encounter_basis: Dunk outdrinking the gobsmacked fauns is a memorable meeting distinct from the potion scheme's outcome.

items.change: Uriah bonded with Ingrid over criticizing Father William and learned about the forest religion and Vivian.
items.impact_basis: Beats_60-62 add context about the forest faith, the fairies and Vivian.
items.lasting_basis: Vivian and the fairies may come up later.
items.encounter_basis: A friendly exchange revealing Ingrid's faith and the church-forest tension that would otherwise be lost.

items.change: The party regrouped, shared what they had learned and decided to head to the Barrow.
items.impact_basis: Beat_69 sets the party's course.
items.lasting_basis: The course leads into next Session.
items.encounter_basis: A planning meeting already told by the sword thread.

items.change: Dunk gave Ingrid diluted faun wine for the potion.
items.impact_basis: Beat_70 advances the scheme.
items.lasting_basis: The potion is pending.
items.encounter_basis: The same event the Ingrid potion thread tells.

items.change: The party sent Squints in to rescue Brother Dirk from a sleeping giant, then fled.
items.impact_basis: Beats_76-81 rescue an NPC, create a foe and add Dirk as a follower.
items.lasting_basis: The angry giant and Dirk persist.
items.encounter_basis: A defining rescue already told by the giant thread.
